NANO SCIENCE &
TECHNOLOGY
PROGRAM
Admission
The NSNT Program aims at training students with solid knowledge in nano material process, nano material characterization, nano device design and fabrication, nano structural observation and manipulation, etc. The graduates from this program should be creative and able to lead a nano technological project investigation.
With the program, it leads to the degrees of Master of Philosophy (MPhil) or Doctor of Philosophy (PhD). Applicants are expected to hold a bachelor’s degree in science, engineering or related field with satisfactory performance. The program committee will evaluate the applications and conduct interview if necessary.
For admission information, please refer to the following link:
https://pg.ust.hk/prospective-students/admissions/how-to-apply
